'''Yliri Consta''' was a [[Hapan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in the aftermath of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], and was the sister of [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] actress [[Sarita Consta]]. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] arrived on Dathomir looking for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]], they hired Consta to be their lead [[Pilot/Legends|driver]]. [[Dyon Stadd]] suspected her of having feelings for [[Carrack]].
